correctness.rationale: For the 12-vertex truncated-tetrahedral graph with vertices ordered pairs (i,j) of four distinct labels, edges have same first coordinate or reversed pair. Its 18 edges and graph diameter3 were independently reconstructed. Enumerated all <=r graph-distance cliques: K1 face vector (12,18,4), K2 (12,42,48,12). Exact mod2 simplicial boundary ranks at K1 are (11,4), at K2 (11,31,12); rational ranks equal these lower bounds by connectivity, chain-square-zero upper bounds, and number of top simplices, yielding H1(K1)=Q³ and H2(K2)=Q⁵. Independent signed simplex actions for all 24 S4 permutations give characters H1 (3,-1,-1,0,1) and H2 (5,1,1,2,-1). Hence H1=sgn⊗Std and H2=Q[4 labels]⊕sgn; only intervals [1,2),[2,3), all other positive homology zero, because graph diameter3. This is mathematically correct but previously entirely proved.
